It reflects the Retail Finance Manager's efficiency in documentation, lender coordination, and process management. Faster approvals improve customer experience and accelerate vehicle deliveries.
Average Login-to-Approval TAT=Total Time Taken for Loan Approvals / Total Approved Finance Cases
Total Time Taken for Approvals = 400 Hours
Daily: Monitor pending approvals and aging cases.
Weekly: Review lender-wise approval timelines and bottlenecks.
Monthly: Evaluate overall finance process efficiency.
Impact on Personal Performance (Retail Finance Manager)
Demonstrates efficiency in managing finance processing and lender relationships.
Reflects accuracy of documentation and case quality.

Enhances customer confidence and purchase experience.
Reduces booking cancellations caused by approval delays.
Improves finance penetration, revenue generation, and operational efficiency.
Lower TAT: Faster approvals, better customer experience, and higher conversion efficiency.
Higher TAT: Indicates delays in documentation, coordination, or lender processing that require corrective action.

Login-to-Approval TAT is a critical process efficiency KPI that measures how quickly finance applications are converted into approved cases. Faster approval timelines improve customer satisfaction, increase retail conversion, and contribute directly to dealership revenue and profitability.

kpis.name: TAT – Approval to Disbursement
kpis.details: Time taken from Case Approval to Case Disbursal
blocks: TAT (Turnaround Time) - Approval to Disbursement measures the average time taken to disburse a loan after it has been approved. It reflects the Retail Finance Manager's ability to coordinate efficiently with customers, lenders, and internal teams to ensure timely fund release and vehicle delivery. Faster disbursement improves customer satisfaction and accelerates retail realization.
Average Approval-to-Disbursement TAT=Total Time Taken from Approval to Disbursement / Total Cases Disbursed
Daily: Monitor approved but pending disbursement cases.
Weekly: Review lender-wise disbursement timelines and delays.
Monthly: Assess overall finance process efficiency.
Impact on Personal Performance (Retail Finance Manager)
Demonstrates efficiency in managing post-approval finance processes.
Reflects strong coordination with banks, financiers, and customers.
Improves finance conversion rates and vehicle delivery readiness.
Supports achievement of finance targets, incentives, and performance ratings.

Reduces booking cancellations caused by funding delays.
Enhances customer experience through faster ownership fulfillment.
Improves cash flow, finance income, and overall dealership profitability.
Lower TAT: Faster fund disbursement, improved customer satisfaction, and stronger retail conversion.
Higher TAT: Indicates delays in documentation, customer compliance, or lender processing that need immediate attention.

Approval-to-Disbursement TAT is a critical finance efficiency KPI that measures how quickly approved loans are converted into funded transactions. A lower TAT enables faster deliveries, better customer experiences, higher finance conversions, and improved dealership business performance.

kpis.name: TAT - Payout
kpis.details: Time taken for Case closure to payment to Dealer
blocks: TAT (Turnaround Time) - Payout measures the average time taken from finance case closure/disbursement to receipt of payout (commission/incentive) from the lending partner to the dealership. It reflects the Retail Finance Manager's effectiveness in documentation, reconciliation, and lender coordination. Faster payouts improve cash flow and profitability for the dealership.
Average Payout TAT=Total Time Taken for Payout Receipt / Total Cases Paid Out
Total Time Taken for Payout Receipt = 500 Days

Weekly: Review lender-wise payout pendency and follow-ups.
Monthly: Assess payout realization efficiency and outstanding receivables.

Demonstrates efficiency in managing lender relationships and payout processes.
Reflects accuracy in documentation, claim submission, and reconciliation.
Contributes to achievement of finance revenue targets and performance ratings.
Highlights the ability to minimize payout leakages and delays.
Improves cash flow and working capital availability.
Ensures timely realization of finance commission income.
Reduces outstanding receivables and financial reconciliation issues.
Enhances overall dealership profitability and financial efficiency.
Lower Payout TAT: Faster revenue realization, stronger lender coordination, and healthier cash flow.
Higher Payout TAT: Indicates delays in documentation, claim processing, or lender settlements requiring corrective action.

Payout TAT is a critical finance operations KPI that measures how quickly finance-related earnings are realized by the dealership. A lower TAT improves cash flow, enhances profitability, and reflects strong process discipline and financial management.

kpis.name: Preferred financier Mix
kpis.details: %age cases closed through Preferred Financier
blocks: Preferred Financier Mix measures the percentage of finance cases sourced through approved or preferred finance partners. Preferred Financier Mix (%)=(Cases Closed Through Preferred Financiers / Total Finance Cases Closed)×100
Weekly: Review financier mix trends and conversion performance.
Monthly: Assess achievement against preferred financier targets.

Demonstrates effective management of lender relationships and business allocation.

Contributes to finance targets, incentives, and performance ratings.

Enhances finance income through better payout structures and partner incentives.

Lower Preferred Financier Mix: Indicates opportunities to strengthen preferred partner engagement, product positioning, or customer financing advocacy.

Preferred Financier Mix is a strategic finance KPI that measures how effectively finance business is routed through approved lending partners. A higher mix drives better profitability, faster turnaround times, stronger lender relationships, and enhanced business performance for the dealership.

kpis.name: Wholesale
kpis.details: Total vehicles lifted from OEM
blocks: Wholesale measures the total number of vehicles procured or lifted from the OEM during a defined period. For a GM Sales, it is a key indicator of inventory planning, market demand forecasting, and preparedness to meet retail targets. Effective wholesale management ensures the right stock is available to support sales growth while avoiding excess inventory.

Effective wholesale management ensures stock availability, supports retail growth, optimizes working capital, and contributes directly to dealership profitability and business success.

kpis.name: Inventory Management / Ageing Management
kpis.details: Average ageing days of new vehicle inventory

Inventory Ageing Management measures the average number of days new vehicles remain in stock before being retailed. It is a critical KPI for a GM Sales as it reflects inventory planning efficiency, stock rotation effectiveness, and working capital management. Lower ageing ensures healthier inventory, faster stock turnover, and improved profitability.

kpis.name: CSI & Complaint Mgt.
kpis.details: Overall CSI Score for the Dealership and Customer Complaint Ratio for the Dealership
blocks: CSI & Complaint Management measures the dealership's ability to deliver exceptional customer experiences while effectively resolving customer concerns. Low CSI & High Complaint Ratio: Indicates service gaps requiring immediate management attention and corrective actions.

CSI & Complaint Management is a strategic business KPI that measures both customer satisfaction and service quality. High CSI scores combined with low complaint ratios create loyal customers, strengthen dealership reputation, and drive sustainable growth and profitability.

kpis.name: VAS (Fin/Ins/Acc)

Lower VAS Penetration: Indicates missed revenue opportunities and the need for stronger product positioning and customer engagement.

Sales Department Profitability is the ultimate measure of business success for a GM Sales. It reflects how effectively sales volume, pricing, inventory, and value-added services are managed to generate sustainable profits, ensuring long-term dealership growth and financial health.

kpis.name: Market Share

Market Share is a strategic growth KPI that measures the dealership's ability to capture its fair share of the market. A higher market share reflects strong sales execution, superior customer engagement, and sustainable business growth, making it one of the most important indicators of dealership success.

Total Sales Contribution is the ultimate profitability KPI for a GM Sales.
